titulo: Another big James Talarico interview is punted to YouTube due to FCC threats
cuerpo: Jimmy Kimmel will be interviewing Democratic Texas Senate candidate James Talarico "under unusual circumstances," posting the interview directly to YouTube, rather than airing it on TV during Jimmy Kimmel Live.
